description: A coloring page lies on the bed in front, with a box of Crayola 64 crayons set just above the paper. The left hand rests on and steadies the paper as the right hand reaches into the crayon box, pulls out a light-blue crayon (right-hand object), then moves down to the drawing and colors short strokes along the top rim and upper area of the bottle near the bow while the left hand keeps the page from sliding.
